parameters.query: SELECT l.id AS listing_id, l.title, l.description, l.tags, l.price, l.status AS local_status, p.kind, s.id AS shop_pk, s.etsy_shop_id, s.oauth_token, s.refresh_token, s.token_expires FROM listings l JOIN products p ON p.id = l.product_id JOIN shops s ON s.id = p.shop_id WHERE l.id = $1;
UPDATE shops SET oauth_token = $1, refresh_token = $2, token_expires = $3 WHERE id = $4 RETURNING id;

parameters.body: ={{ Object.entries($json.payload).filter(([,v]) => v !== null && v !== undefined).flatMap(([k,v]) => Array.isArray(v) ? v.map(x => `${k}=${encodeURIComponent(x)}`) : [`${k}=${encodeURIComponent(v)}`]).join('&') }}

parameters.query: UPDATE listings SET etsy_listing_id = $1, status = 'published', updated_at = now() WHERE id = $2 RETURNING id, etsy_listing_id, status;

meta.description: POST /webhook/etsy-listing-publish {listing_id} → fetch listing+shop, refresh token if within 60s of expiry (writing back to shops), POST createDraftListing to Etsy v3, mark local listing published with the returned etsy_listing_id. Listings land in Etsy in 'draft' state for human review before going live; flip 'state' to 'active' once you trust outputs.
